title: NATO’s New Theory of Victory: How AI and Drones Change Military Deterrence
description:
NATO has unveiled a new 'Theory of Victory' that puts AI-powered drones at the center of European security. We break down what this means for the future of military deterrence and your local defense procurement news.

What we covered:
• NATO Drafts 'Theory of Victory' Using AI and Drones Against Eastern Flank Incursions
• Norway Proposes Temporary Ban on AI Glasses in Public Spaces
• Google pauses open-source bug bounty program after surge in AI-generated submissions

Three distinct AI stories, with lively debate, useful discoveries and practical takeaways.

Listener question: If you saw someone wearing AI glasses in a public park, would you feel your privacy was being violated?

What to watch tomorrow: not which AI headline was loudest, but which one quietly changed the rules.

Alex, Jamie and Rufus tell you what changed in AI, who wins, and what you do next.
